svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rip a strip 1,074 x 52.5 mm from 12 mm exterior plywood.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the low end (toward the outlets) and the high end (feed).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pivot hole 10.5 mm: 25 mm from the low end, 10 mm up from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom edge. Prop hinge hole 10.5 mm: 67 mm from the high end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10 mm up. Drill square to the face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Prop block: 45 x 45 mm timber 120 mm long, glued (exterior PU) and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screwed (4 x 40 mm, 4 screws) to the outside face, 7 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: high end, its bottom 12 mm below the wall (over the base ring).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the prop hinge hole on through the block.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the end walls sit between the side walls; glue and three

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4 x 40 mm screws per corner through the side wall into the end wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seal all edges with exterior paint before assembly.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both walls the same length within 1 mm; holes mirror-imaged.
